essence: For such a person, imperishability is asserted rather than cessation by death.
Agitation in that agent is presented as capable of shaking the whole triple world.
The character of accomplishment corresponds directly to the character of unceasing practice.
Among forms of knowledge, this autonomy-oriented knowledge is claimed as supreme.
One desiring accomplishment is enjoined to take this teaching with effort in the Kaula path.
